blocks.zh: 直接接觸蒸汽滅菌 — 完整教學版
blocks.en: Direct-Contact Steam Sterilization: Complete Tutorial

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Chapter Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解飽和蒸汽（Saturated Steam）的物理特性及其為何對滅菌至關重要
blocks.en: Understand the physical properties of saturated steam and why they are essential to sterilization

blocks.zh: 掌握 F<sub>0</sub> 公式的含義與計算邏輯 — 以 121°C 為基準溫度、z-value = 10°C
blocks.en: Understand the meaning and calculation logic of the F<sub>0</sub> formula, with 121°C as the reference temperature and a z-value of 10°C

blocks.zh: 區分重力排氣循環（Gravity Displacement）與預真空循環（Prevacuum）的原理與適用場景
blocks.en: Distinguish the principles and applications of gravity displacement cycles and prevacuum cycles

blocks.zh: 理解 Overkill 滅菌法的驗證策略：設備確認、空腔溫度分佈、組件映射、負載映射
blocks.en: Understand the validation strategy of the overkill sterilization approach: equipment qualification, empty-chamber temperature distribution, component mapping, and load mapping

blocks.zh: 掌握生物指示劑（BI）的選擇與放置原則，以及熱穿透/微生物挑戰研究的設計
blocks.en: Understand the principles for selecting and placing biological indicators (BIs), and how to design heat penetration and microbiological challenge studies

blocks.zh: 將 USP 〈1229.1〉 原則應用於 CDMO 高壓滅菌器驗證與日常操作
blocks.en: Apply the principles of USP <1229.1> to autoclave validation and routine operation in a CDMO

blocks.zh: Scope and Background — 範圍與背景
blocks.en: Scope and Background

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 〈1229.1〉 的適用範圍：本章專門討論蒸汽與被滅菌物品直接接觸的情境。這包括：
blocks.en: Scope of <1229.1>: This chapter addresses situations where steam is in direct contact with the items being sterilized. This includes:

blocks.zh: 設備零組件 — 充填機零件、濾殼（filter housings）、管路（tubing）、軟管（hoses）
blocks.en: Equipment components - filling machine parts, filter housings, tubing, hoses

blocks.zh: 容器/封蓋 — 西林瓶塞（stoppers）、鋁蓋（seals）、玻璃瓶
blocks.en: Containers/closures - vial stoppers, aluminum seals, glass bottles

blocks.zh: 工具/器具 — 刮刀、燒杯、量筒等簡單幾何形狀的器具
blocks.en: Tools/utensils - spatulas, beakers, graduated cylinders, and other utensils of simple geometry

blocks.zh: 不適用範圍：液體產品的容器滅菌（如安瓿、預充填針筒中的液體），那屬於 〈1229.2〉 的範疇。
blocks.en: Out of scope: Sterilization of liquid-filled containers (such as liquids in ampoules or prefilled syringes) falls under <1229.2>.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 CDMO Context
blocks.en: Key Point: CDMO Context

blocks.zh: 為什麼這是「最常用」的滅菌方法？在無菌製造的 CDMO 環境中，每一批產品生產前，所有與產品接觸的設備零件、容器封蓋都必須經過滅菌。高壓蒸汽滅菌（Autoclave）是首選方法，因為：
blocks.en: Why is this the "most commonly used" sterilization method? In a CDMO aseptic manufacturing environment, all product-contact equipment parts and container closures must be sterilized before each batch is produced. Steam sterilization (autoclaving) is the method of choice because:

blocks.zh: 殺滅力最強 — 飽和蒸汽的相變釋能機制遠勝乾熱
blocks.en: Strongest lethality - the energy release on phase change of saturated steam is far more effective than dry heat

blocks.zh: 可重複驗證 — 溫度-壓力的唯一對應關係使監控簡單可靠
blocks.en: Reproducible validation - the unique relationship between temperature and pressure makes monitoring simple and reliable

blocks.zh: 適用 Overkill — 對於耐熱物品，可以採用最寬裕的滅菌條件
blocks.en: Suited to overkill - for heat-stable items, the most generous sterilization conditions can be applied

blocks.zh: Saturated Steam — 飽和蒸汽
blocks.en: Saturated Steam

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Saturated Steam Properties
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Saturated Steam Properties

blocks.zh: 飽和蒸汽的兩大殺菌優勢：
blocks.en: Two microbial-kill advantages of saturated steam:

blocks.zh: 液態水的存在 — 水分子能穿透微生物的細胞壁，導致蛋白質水解變性（hydrolysis），這比乾熱的氧化機制快得多
blocks.en: Presence of liquid water - water molecules penetrate the microbial cell wall and cause hydrolysis and denaturation of proteins, which is much faster than the oxidative mechanism of dry heat

blocks.zh: 相變釋能 — 蒸汽凝結為水時釋放巨大潛熱（2202 kJ/kg），迅速將熱能傳遞給負載表面
blocks.en: Energy release on phase change - when steam condenses to water it releases a large amount of latent heat (2202 kJ/kg), rapidly transferring heat to the load surface

blocks.zh: 溫度-壓力唯一對應：在飽和狀態下，121°C 對應約 1.06 bar（表壓）/ 2.06 bar（絕對壓力）。這個對應關係是我們能用壓力間接確認溫度的基礎。
blocks.en: Unique temperature-pressure relationship: In the saturated state, 121°C corresponds to about 1.06 bar (gauge) / 2.06 bar (absolute). This relationship is the basis for confirming temperature indirectly from pressure.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 為什麼過熱蒸汽反而殺菌力弱？
blocks.en: Why is superheated steam actually less effective at killing microorganisms?

blocks.zh: 想像用蒸氣熨斗燙衣服：噴出「濕潤蒸汽」的熨斗能迅速把衣服燙平，因為水蒸汽碰到布料時凝結釋放熱量，直接穿透纖維。但如果你用「乾燥的熱風」，即使溫度更高，效果反而差 — 因為缺少液態水的直接接觸和凝結釋能。
blocks.en: Think of ironing clothes with a steam iron: an iron that emits "moist steam" smooths clothes quickly, because the steam condenses on the fabric, releases its heat, and penetrates the fibers directly. But if you use "dry hot air," the result is worse even at a higher temperature, because there is no direct contact with liquid water and no energy release on condensation.

blocks.zh: 過熱蒸汽就像「乾燥熱風」— 溫度高但缺少液態水，殺菌效率大幅下降。
blocks.en: Superheated steam is like "dry hot air": the temperature is high, but without liquid water the sterilization efficiency drops sharply.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Air Removal Is Critical
blocks.en: Key Point: Air Removal Is Critical

blocks.zh: 殘餘空氣的致命影響：
blocks.en: The critical impact of residual air:

blocks.zh: 絕熱效應 — 空氣是熱的不良導體，形成隔熱層阻擋蒸汽接觸物品表面
blocks.en: Insulating effect - air is a poor conductor of heat and forms an insulating layer that keeps steam from contacting the item surface

blocks.zh: 破壞溫度-壓力關係 — 空氣+蒸汽的混合氣體，其壓力 = 蒸汽分壓 + 空氣分壓（Dalton’s Law）。此時壓力表讀數不再反映真實蒸汽溫度
blocks.en: Disrupts the temperature-pressure relationship - in an air-steam mixture, total pressure = partial pressure of steam + partial pressure of air (Dalton’s Law). The pressure gauge reading then no longer reflects the true steam temperature

blocks.zh: 實際後果 — 壓力表顯示達到滅菌壓力，但實際溫度可能不足，產生「假陽性」的滅菌結果
blocks.en: Practical consequence - the pressure gauge shows that sterilization pressure has been reached, but the actual temperature may be insufficient, producing a "false positive" sterilization result

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼空氣排除測試（如 Bowie-Dick Test）在預真空滅菌器中是每日必做的確認項目。
blocks.en: This is why an air removal test (such as the Bowie-Dick test) is a confirmation that must be performed daily on prevacuum sterilizers.

blocks.zh: Gravity Displacement Cycles — 重力排氣循環
blocks.en: Gravity Displacement Cycles

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Gravity Displacement
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Gravity Displacement

blocks.zh: 工作原理：利用蒸汽與空氣的密度差異進行自然排氣。蒸汽密度低（輕），自然上升；空氣密度高（重），自然下沉並從底部排出。
blocks.en: Principle of operation: Air is removed naturally by the density difference between steam and air. Steam has a low density (light) and rises naturally; air has a high density (heavy) and sinks naturally and is discharged from the bottom.

blocks.zh: 蒸汽入口 — 通常在腔室頂部或上方
blocks.en: Steam inlet - usually at or near the top of the chamber

blocks.zh: 排氣口 — 位於腔室底部，經過恆溫疏水閥（Thermostatic Trap）
blocks.en: Exhaust outlet - located at the bottom of the chamber, passing through a thermostatic trap

blocks.zh: 恆溫疏水閥 — 感測流體溫度：冷凝水和空氣（溫度低）通過排出；蒸汽（溫度高）被阻擋留在腔內
blocks.en: Thermostatic trap - senses the temperature of the fluid: condensate and air (lower temperature) are allowed to pass and be discharged; steam (higher temperature) is blocked and retained in the chamber

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Practical Limitations
blocks.en: Key Point: Practical Limitations

blocks.zh: CDMO 環境中的考量：
blocks.en: Considerations in a CDMO environment:

blocks.zh: 升溫慢 — 重力排氣依賴自然對流，對於複雜或密集的負載，空氣排除不完全的風險較高
blocks.en: Slow heat-up - gravity displacement relies on natural convection, so for complex or dense loads the risk of incomplete air removal is higher

blocks.zh: 冷凝水滯留 — 如果包裝材料或負載排列不當，冷凝水無法順利排出，形成「水窪」阻礙蒸汽接觸
blocks.en: Condensate retention - if the wrapping materials or load arrangement are improper, condensate cannot drain properly and forms "puddles" that block steam contact

blocks.zh: 適用場景 — 簡單金屬工具、不包裝的玻璃器皿等。複雜充填零件通常使用預真空循環
blocks.en: Suitable applications - simple metal tools, unwrapped glassware, and so on. Complex filling parts are usually sterilized using a prevacuum cycle

blocks.zh: Prevacuum Cycles — 預真空循環
blocks.en: Prevacuum Cycles

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Prevacuum Mechanism
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Prevacuum Mechanism

blocks.zh: 多脈衝抽真空/注蒸汽循環：
blocks.en: Multi-pulse vacuum/steam injection cycle:

blocks.zh: 第一脈衝 — 抽真空移除大部分空氣，注入蒸汽
blocks.en: First pulse - a vacuum is drawn to remove most of the air, and steam is injected

blocks.zh: 第二脈衝 — 再次抽真空，移除殘餘空氣+蒸汽混合物，再注入新鮮蒸汽
blocks.en: Second pulse - a vacuum is drawn again to remove the residual air-steam mixture, and fresh steam is injected

blocks.zh: 第三脈衝（或更多） — 持續稀釋殘餘空氣，達到接近 100% 蒸汽的環境
blocks.en: Third pulse (or more) - continues to dilute the residual air until the environment is close to 100% steam

blocks.zh: 每次脈衝後，腔內空氣濃度呈指數下降。典型的預真空循環使用 3-4 次脈衝。
blocks.en: After each pulse, the air concentration in the chamber falls exponentially. A typical prevacuum cycle uses 3-4 pulses.

blocks.zh: 洗衣機的脫水原理：預真空循環就像洗衣機的多次「注水–排水」循環 — 每次排水（抽真空）後再注入新的清潔水（蒸汽），反覆幾次就能把衣物中的髒水（空氣）徹底稀釋排出。單靠自然滲透（重力排氣）是不夠的。
blocks.en: The washing machine spin-out principle: A prevacuum cycle is like the repeated "fill-drain" cycles of a washing machine: after each drain (vacuum), fresh clean water (steam) is added, and after a few repetitions the dirty water (air) in the laundry is thoroughly diluted and removed. Natural permeation alone (gravity displacement) is not enough.

blocks.zh: Sterilization Cycle Control & F<sub>0</sub> Calculation — 滅菌循環控制與 F<sub>0</sub> 計算
blocks.en: Sterilization Cycle Control & F<sub>0</sub> Calculation: Controlling the Cycle by F<sub>0</sub>

blocks.zh: F<sub>0</sub> Formula — F<sub>0</sub> 公式
blocks.en: F<sub>0</sub> Formula: Calculating F<sub>0</sub>

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 F<sub>0</sub> Interpretation
blocks.en: Key Concepts: F<sub>0</sub> Interpretation

blocks.zh: F0 的本質：將不同溫度下的滅菌效果，統一換算為「在 121°C 下的等效暴露分鐘數」。
blocks.en: The essence of F0: It converts the sterilization effect at different temperatures into a single "equivalent number of minutes of exposure at 121°C."

blocks.zh: F0 = 15 min — 等效於在 121°C 暴露 15 分鐘的滅菌效果
blocks.en: F0 = 15 min - equivalent to the sterilization effect of 15 minutes of exposure at 121°C

blocks.zh: Overkill 標準 — 常見要求 F0 ≥ 15 min（半循環法基礎）或更高
blocks.en: Overkill standard - a commonly required value is F0 ≥ 15 min (the basis of the half-cycle approach) or higher

blocks.zh: 121°C 不是魔法數字 — 它只是 250°F 的攝氏換算值，USP 明確指出可以使用其他溫度
blocks.en: 121°C is not a magic number - it is simply the Celsius equivalent of 250°F, and USP states explicitly that other temperatures may be used

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Control Sensor Location
blocks.en: Key Point: Control Sensor Location

blocks.zh: 為什麼控制探頭在排水管線（Drain Line）？排水管位於腔室底部，是最後被蒸汽到達的位置（因為冷空氣和冷凝水積聚在此）。當排水管溫度達標時，代表整個腔室都已達到滅菌溫度 — 這是最保守、最安全的控制策略。
blocks.en: Why is the control probe in the drain line? The drain line is at the bottom of the chamber and is the last place reached by steam (because cold air and condensate collect there). When the drain line reaches the target temperature, the whole chamber has reached sterilization temperature. This is the most conservative and safest control strategy.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Practical Calculation Example
blocks.en: Key Point: Practical Calculation Example

blocks.zh: 關鍵觀察：溫度每升高 10°C，滅菌速率增加 10 倍。從 121°C 到 131°C，F0 累積速度快 10 倍。
blocks.en: Key observation: For every 10°C increase in temperature, the sterilization rate increases 10-fold. From 121°C to 131°C, F0 accumulates 10 times faster.

blocks.zh: F0 計算起點：USP 規定應從 100°C 開始計算，並持續到保溫期結束（前提是維持飽和蒸汽條件）。
blocks.en: Starting point of the F0 calculation: USP specifies that the calculation should begin at 100°C and continue to the end of the hold period (provided that saturated steam conditions are maintained).

blocks.zh: Validation of Sterilization by Direct Contact — 直接接觸滅菌驗證
blocks.en: Validation of Sterilization by Direct Contact

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Overkill Method
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Overkill Method

blocks.zh: Overkill（過度殺滅）的三種證明途徑：
blocks.en: Three ways to demonstrate overkill:

blocks.zh: 最低 F0 法 — 所有監測點的 F0 值達到預設最低標準（常見 ≥ 15 min 或 ≥ 12 min）
blocks.en: Minimum F0 method - the F0 value at all monitoring points reaches a predefined minimum (commonly ≥ 15 min or ≥ 12 min)

blocks.zh: 物理條件法 — 達到預設的最低溫度持續預設的最低時間（如 121°C × 15 min）
blocks.en: Physical conditions method - a predefined minimum temperature is achieved for a predefined minimum time (e.g., 121°C × 15 min)

blocks.zh: BI 對數降低法 — 確認高抗性生物指示劑（如 106 spores of G. stearothermophilus）在半循環條件下全部被殺滅
blocks.en: BI log reduction method - confirm that a high-resistance biological indicator (such as 106 spores of G. stearothermophilus) is completely killed under half-cycle conditions

blocks.zh: 「如果能殺死最強的敵人，普通敵人更不在話下」：
blocks.en: "If you can defeat the strongest opponent, ordinary opponents are no problem":

blocks.zh: Overkill 的邏輯就像軍事訓練 — 如果你的防禦系統能擊退最精銳的特種部隊（高抗性 BI 芽孢），那對付一般的入侵者（日常生物負載）自然綽綽有餘。這樣你就不需要花大量資源去了解每批產品的具體敵情（bioburden characterization），大大簡化了驗證工作。
blocks.en: The logic of overkill is like military training: if your defenses can repel the most elite special forces (high-resistance BI spores), then ordinary intruders (routine bioburden) are easily handled. You then do not need to spend a great deal of resources learning the specific threat posed by each batch of product (bioburden characterization), which greatly simplifies the validation work.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Why Overkill Is Preferred
blocks.en: Key Point: Why Overkill Is Preferred

blocks.zh: CDMO 為什麼幾乎都用 Overkill？
blocks.en: Why do CDMOs almost always use overkill?

blocks.zh: 驗證簡單 — 不需要進行生物負載的深入鑑定和抗性測試
blocks.en: Simple validation - no in-depth bioburden identification or resistance testing is needed

blocks.zh: 換產品風險低 — CDMO 經常切換不同客戶的產品，Overkill 不依賴特定產品的 bioburden 數據
blocks.en: Low risk when changing products - a CDMO frequently switches between different clients’ products, and overkill does not depend on product-specific bioburden data

blocks.zh: 法規審查容易 — Overkill 是最保守的方法，稽查員對此接受度最高
blocks.en: Easy regulatory review - overkill is the most conservative approach and has the highest acceptance among inspectors

blocks.zh: 可以超標 — 直接接觸滅菌中，超過 F0 最低值不會損害耐熱負載
blocks.en: Exceeding the minimum is acceptable - in direct-contact sterilization, exceeding the minimum F0 does not damage heat-stable loads

blocks.zh: Equipment Qualification — 設備確認
blocks.en: Equipment Qualification

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Equipment Qualification
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Equipment Qualification

blocks.zh: IQ/OQ 的目的：確認滅菌器在未放入任何負載的情況下，本身的基本功能是否正常。
blocks.en: Purpose of IQ/OQ: To confirm that the sterilizer itself functions properly, with no load in the chamber.

blocks.zh: IQ（Installation Qualification） — 確認設備按設計安裝：管路連接、公用設施（蒸汽、壓縮空氣、排水）、控制系統、校準
blocks.en: IQ (Installation Qualification) - confirms the equipment is installed as designed: piping connections, utilities (steam, compressed air, drain), control system, calibration

blocks.zh: OQ（Operational Qualification） — 確認設備在空腔狀態下運行正常：溫度分佈均勻、真空洩漏率、控制邏輯
blocks.en: OQ (Operational Qualification) - confirms the equipment operates properly in the empty-chamber state: uniform temperature distribution, vacuum leak rate, control logic

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Empty Chamber Study
blocks.en: Key Point: Empty Chamber Study

blocks.zh: 空腔溫度分佈研究要點：
blocks.en: Key points of the empty-chamber temperature distribution study:

blocks.zh: 探頭位置 — 腔室各角落附近 + 控制探頭附近 + 其他適當位置（通常 10-15 支熱電偶）
blocks.en: Probe locations - near each corner of the chamber + near the control probe + other appropriate locations (typically 10-15 thermocouples)

blocks.zh: 僅用腔內探頭 — 排水管或腔外的溫度不計入此測試（它們有其他用途）
blocks.en: In-chamber probes only - temperatures in the drain line or outside the chamber are not counted in this test (they serve other purposes)

blocks.zh: 最短保溫時間 — 只需測試該排氣方式的最短循環即可（最嚴格條件）
blocks.en: Shortest hold time - only the shortest cycle for that exhaust method needs to be tested (the most stringent condition)

blocks.zh: 不需要 BI — 空腔研究是純物理測量，不使用生物指示劑
blocks.en: No BI needed - the empty-chamber study is a purely physical measurement and does not use biological indicators

blocks.zh: 常見接受標準：所有探頭在保溫期間的溫度偏差通常 ≤ ±1.0°C（依設備規格和使用目的而定）。
blocks.en: Common acceptance criterion: The temperature deviation of all probes during the hold period is typically ≤ ±1.0°C (depending on equipment specifications and intended use).

blocks.zh: Component Mapping — 組件映射
blocks.en: Component Mapping

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Component Mapping
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Component Mapping

blocks.zh: 組件映射的目的：找出每個被滅菌物品的「最冷點」（Cold Spot）— 即蒸汽最難到達、溫度最後升到的位置。
blocks.en: Purpose of component mapping: To find the "cold spot" of each item being sterilized, that is, the location that steam reaches with the most difficulty and where the temperature rises last.

blocks.zh: 為什麼重要？如果最冷點都能達到滅菌條件，其他位置一定沒問題。這是「最差條件驗證」的核心邏輯。
blocks.en: Why is it important? If the cold spot achieves sterilization conditions, every other location will certainly be fine. This is the core logic of "worst-case validation."

blocks.zh: 重點提示 CDMO Practical Examples
blocks.en: Key Point: CDMO Practical Examples

blocks.zh: 典型 CDMO 組件的冷點分析：
blocks.en: Cold-spot analysis of typical CDMO components:

blocks.zh: 關鍵規則：組件映射研究可以在實驗室做，不需要在每台滅菌器上重複。但包裝方式和放置方向必須與實際一致。
blocks.en: Key rule: Component mapping studies can be performed in the laboratory and do not need to be repeated on every sterilizer. However, the wrapping method and orientation must match actual use.

blocks.zh: Load Mapping — 負載映射
blocks.en: Load Mapping

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Load Mapping vs Component Mapping
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Load Mapping vs Component Mapping

blocks.zh: 直接接觸滅菌的關鍵差異：與液體滅菌不同，負載在腔室中的位置不是主要影響因素。更重要的是組件本身的特性（幾何形狀、質量、包裝方式）。
blocks.en: The key difference in direct-contact sterilization: Unlike liquid sterilization, the position of the load in the chamber is not the main influencing factor. More important are the characteristics of the component itself (geometry, mass, wrapping method).

blocks.zh: 驗證策略：最大/最小負載
blocks.en: Validation strategy: maximum/minimum load

blocks.zh: 最大負載 — 代表最多物品、最大蒸汽需求、最多冷凝水的情境
blocks.en: Maximum load - represents the scenario with the most items, the greatest steam demand, and the most condensate

blocks.zh: 最小負載 — 代表最少物品的情境（某些設備在低負載時可能有不同的表現）
blocks.en: Minimum load - represents the scenario with the fewest items (some equipment may perform differently at low loads)

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Best Practice
blocks.en: Key Point: Best Practice

blocks.zh: 大件物品放下層的原因：大件物品產生更多冷凝水。將它們放在下層，冷凝水直接流入底部排水口，不會滴落到下方其他物品上造成濕潤阻礙。
blocks.en: Why large items go on the lower shelf: Large items generate more condensate. Placing them on the lower shelf lets the condensate run directly into the bottom drain, rather than dripping onto other items below and causing wetting that impedes steam contact.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：通常會定義若干標準負載配置（Standard Load Configurations），並以 SOP 和照片記錄每種配置的擺放方式。操作人員依照 SOP 擺放，不允許隨意變更。
blocks.en: CDMO practice: Several standard load configurations are usually defined, and the arrangement of each is documented in an SOP with photographs. Operators load according to the SOP, and arbitrary changes are not permitted.

blocks.zh: Biological Indicators — 生物指示劑
blocks.en: Biological Indicators

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Biological Indicators
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Biological Indicators

blocks.zh: Geobacillus stearothermophilus 被選為蒸汽滅菌 BI 的原因：
blocks.en: Geobacillus stearothermophilus is selected as the BI for steam sterilization because:

blocks.zh: 嗜熱性 — 最適生長溫度 55-60°C，芽孢在濕熱條件下的抗性遠高於常見微生物
blocks.en: Thermophilic - its optimum growth temperature is 55-60°C, and its spores are far more resistant to moist heat than common microorganisms

blocks.zh: 已知 D-value — 在 121°C 下，D-value 通常為 1.5-3.0 分鐘（依菌株和製備條件而定）
blocks.en: Known D-value - at 121°C the D-value is typically 1.5-3.0 minutes (depending on strain and preparation conditions)

blocks.zh: 標準化菌株 — ATCC 12980 和 ATCC 7953 是全球公認的標準菌株
blocks.en: Standardized strains - ATCC 12980 and ATCC 7953 are the internationally recognized standard strains

blocks.zh: 重點提示 BI Placement
blocks.en: Key Point: BI Placement

blocks.zh: 兩種 BI 使用方式：
blocks.en: Two ways of using BIs:

blocks.zh: 商業 BI — 放置在負載物品內/上。可直接使用供應商提供的族群數（Population）和 D-value 數據
blocks.en: Commercial BI - placed in/on the load items. The population and D-value data provided by the supplier can be used directly

blocks.zh: 自製接種 BI — 將芽孢懸浮液接種在實際物品上。使用者必須自行測定族群數和抗性，不能使用供應商數據
blocks.en: Self-inoculated BI - a spore suspension is inoculated onto the actual items. The user must determine the population and resistance independently and cannot use the supplier’s data

blocks.zh: CDMO 常見做法：使用商業 BI（如 Mesa Labs、3M 產品），放置在組件映射研究中確定的冷點位置。
blocks.en: Common CDMO practice: Use commercial BIs (such as Mesa Labs or 3M products), placed at the cold-spot locations identified in the component mapping study.

blocks.zh: Heat Penetration and Microbiological Challenge — 熱穿透與微生物挑戰
blocks.en: Heat Penetration and Microbiological Challenge

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Half-Cycle Approach
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Half-Cycle Approach

blocks.zh: 減少暴露條件（Reduced Conditions）：這就是著名的半循環法（Half-Cycle Method）的基礎。例如：
blocks.en: Reduced exposure conditions: This is the basis of the well-known half-cycle method. For example:

blocks.zh: 常規循環：121°C × 30 min
blocks.en: Routine cycle: 121°C × 30 min

blocks.zh: 驗證循環：121°C × 15 min（半循環）
blocks.en: Validation cycle: 121°C × 15 min (half cycle)

blocks.zh: 邏輯：如果在半循環條件下，所有 BI（通常 106 spores）都被殺滅，那麼常規的全循環提供的殺滅力至少是驗證循環的兩倍，安全裕度極大。
blocks.en: Logic: If all BIs (typically 106 spores) are killed under half-cycle conditions, then the routine full cycle provides at least twice the lethality of the validation cycle, a very large safety margin.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 TC/BI Placement Rules
blocks.en: Key Point: TC/BI Placement Rules

blocks.zh: 熱電偶（TC）和 BI 的放置規則：
blocks.en: Placement rules for thermocouples (TCs) and BIs:

blocks.zh: 位置 — 放在組件映射研究中確定的最冷點
blocks.en: Location - at the coldest spot identified in the component mapping study

blocks.zh: TC 必須接觸物品表面 — 不是懸掛在空氣中，而是貼附在物品表面
blocks.en: The TC must contact the item surface - not suspended in the air but attached to the surface of the item

blocks.zh: 不能改變蒸汽穿透路徑 — 插入 TC 和 BI 時不能影響蒸汽進入物品的方式（如不能打開原本密封的蓋子）
blocks.en: Must not alter the steam penetration path - inserting the TC and BI must not affect how steam enters the item (for example, a lid that is normally sealed must not be opened)

blocks.zh: 解決方案 — 使用專用的 TC 穿入接頭（thermocouple port fittings），或將 TC 放在相鄰的對照組件中
blocks.en: Solution - use dedicated thermocouple port fittings, or place the TC in an adjacent control component

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Acceptance Criteria
blocks.en: Key Point: Acceptance Criteria

blocks.zh: 物理與微生物結果必須一致：
blocks.en: Physical and microbiological results must agree:

blocks.zh: 物理測量 — 所有 TC 的 F0 ≥ 預設最低值
blocks.en: Physical measurement - F0 at all TCs ≥ the predefined minimum

blocks.zh: 微生物測量 — 所有 BI 無生長（No Growth）
blocks.en: Microbiological measurement - no growth in all BIs

blocks.zh: 兩者不一致 = 調查 — 例如 TC 顯示 F0 達標但 BI 陽性，可能表示蒸汽品質問題（非凝結性氣體、過熱）
blocks.en: Disagreement = investigation - for example, if the TCs show that F0 was achieved but the BI is positive, this may indicate a steam quality problem (non-condensable gases, superheat)

blocks.zh: Routine Process Control — 日常製程控制
blocks.en: Routine Process Control

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Validated State Maintenance
blocks.en: Key Concepts: Validated State Maintenance

blocks.zh: 「驗證完成」不是終點，而是起點：驗證建立了基線參數和接受標準。之後的每一次運行都必須在受控狀態下進行，才能確保結果持續可靠。
blocks.en: "Validation complete" is not the finish line but the starting point: Validation establishes baseline parameters and acceptance criteria. Every subsequent run must be performed under controlled conditions to ensure continued reliable results.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 有兩台高壓滅菌器（A 和 B），組件映射研究只在 A 上做過。現在相同的充填針組件要在 B 上滅菌，需要重新做組件映射嗎？為什麼？（提示：USP 原文說了什麼？）
blocks.en: Your CDMO has two autoclaves (A and B), and the component mapping study was performed only on A. The same filling needle assembly now needs to be sterilized in B. Does component mapping need to be repeated? Why? (Hint: what does the original USP text say?)

blocks.zh: 解釋為什麼在半循環驗證中，如果 BI 全部陰性但 TC 測得的 F0 低於預設標準，這個結果是不可接受的？
blocks.en: Explain why, in a half-cycle validation, a result in which all BIs are negative but the F0 measured by the TCs is below the predefined criterion is unacceptable.

blocks.zh: 一位操作員在裝載時將大件充填零件放在滅菌器上層架子，小件工具放在下層。根據 USP 〈1229.1〉 的建議，這種裝載方式有什麼問題？
blocks.en: During loading, an operator places large filling parts on the upper shelf of the sterilizer and small tools on the lower shelf. According to the recommendations of USP <1229.1>, what is wrong with this loading pattern?

blocks.zh: 你的 QA 同事說：「F<sub>0</sub> 達到 121°C × 15 分鐘就夠了，不需要用生物指示劑。」根據 USP 〈1229.1〉 的 Overkill 三種證明途徑，評估這個說法是否正確。
blocks.en: Your QA colleague says: "Reaching F<sub>0</sub> of 121°C × 15 minutes is enough, and there is no need to use biological indicators." Based on the three ways to demonstrate overkill in USP <1229.1>, evaluate whether this statement is correct.

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 飽和蒸汽（Saturated Steam）是直接接觸滅菌的關鍵：液態水的殺菌力 + 相變釋能（2202 kJ/kg）+ 溫度-壓力唯一對應關係
blocks.en: Saturated steam is the key to direct-contact sterilization: the lethality of liquid water + energy release on phase change (2202 kJ/kg) + the unique temperature-pressure relationship

blocks.zh: 空氣排除是成功滅菌的前提 — 殘餘空氣破壞飽和狀態，導致物理測量無法保證殺滅力。重力排氣適用簡單負載，預真空循環適用複雜組件
blocks.en: Air removal is a prerequisite for successful sterilization: residual air disrupts the saturated state, so physical measurements can no longer guarantee lethality. Gravity displacement suits simple loads; prevacuum cycles suit complex components

blocks.zh: F0 公式將不同溫度的殺菌效果統一換算為 121°C 等效分鐘數。計算從 100°C 開始，z-value = 10°C
blocks.en: The F0 formula converts the lethality at different temperatures into equivalent minutes at 121°C. The calculation starts at 100°C, with a z-value of 10°C

blocks.zh: Overkill 方法是直接接觸滅菌的首選驗證策略，可通過三種途徑證明：最低 F0、物理條件、BI 對數降低
blocks.en: The overkill method is the preferred validation strategy for direct-contact sterilization and can be demonstrated in three ways: minimum F0, physical conditions, and BI log reduction

blocks.zh: 驗證流程：設備確認（空腔溫度分佈）→ 組件映射（找冷點）→ 負載映射（最大/最小）→ 熱穿透/微生物挑戰（半循環法）
blocks.en: Validation workflow: equipment qualification (empty-chamber temperature distribution) → component mapping (find cold spots) → load mapping (maximum/minimum) → heat penetration/microbiological challenge (half-cycle method)

blocks.zh: BI：Geobacillus stearothermophilus（ATCC 12980 / 7953），放置在冷點位置
blocks.en: BI: Geobacillus stearothermophilus (ATCC 12980 / 7953), placed at the cold-spot locations

blocks.zh: 日常控制包含訓練、校準、每批記錄、變更控制、預防性維護和定期再評估 — 維持驗證狀態
blocks.en: Routine control includes training, calibration, batch records, change control, preventive maintenance, and periodic requalification, maintaining the validated state
